verdict.rationale: Steel documents a debug URL feature for human-in-the-loop workflows in which users can directly interact with and control a running browser session (steel-docs-5, steel-docs-23). Embeddable sessions (steel-docs-22) support watching a session in progress. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of live-view streaming, details on how control passes between agent and human (pausing the agent and resuming it after takeover), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
